name: Grade 7 IIIT Practice: October Week 7 - Sensor Systems
description: Practice words for micro:bit input and output systems.

words.definition: A sensor value or microbit signal that the Scratch system uses.
words.example: The sensor reading was input for the system.

words.definition: The sound, sprite action, or message produced by the sensor system.
words.example: The output was a sound when the distance was too close.

words.definition: A microbit part that detects distance or movement for Scratch.
words.example: The sensor detected an object in front of the project.

words.definition: A sign or message sent to show information.
words.example: The signal told the program when to show an alert.

words.definition: The sensor limit that changes the Scratch output.
words.example: The threshold changed the output at 15 centimeters.

words.definition: A wireless way for devices to communicate nearby.
words.example: Bluetooth connected the microbit to the computer.

words.definition: A small computer board used for coding projects.
words.example: The microbit sent sensor data to Scratch.
